mapper.select: SELECT u."idUsuario" AS "idUsuario", u."idRol" AS "idRol", u."idTipoUsuario" AS "idTipoUsuario", u.nombre AS "nombre", u."apellidoPaterno" AS "apellidoPaterno", u.password AS "password", u.estatus AS "estatus", r.nombre AS "rol", t.nombre AS "tipoUsuario" FROM public.usuario u INNER JOIN public.rol r ON u."idRol" = r.idrol INNER JOIN public."tipoUsuario" t ON u."idTipoUsuario" = t."idTipo" WHERE u.username = #{username} LIMIT 1;
